# File smells as child work items (non-engine-move) — CG-0MTCOQIRQ00541EJ

## Summary
Create one child Worklog item per distinct non-engine-move smell triaged in detection, with REFACTOR comments at source.

## Goal
As an engine maintainer, every non-auto-fixable, non-engine-move smell is tracked as a child of the epic with severity, description, and file location, and annotated at source to prevent re-filing.

## Acceptance Criteria
1. For each triaged finding NOT flagged engine-move, one child work item created under CG-0MTCOQIRQ00541EJ (distinct smell/instance per AC2): title reflects smell type + location, description includes severity, file:line, smell type, and remediation sketch; priority per producer discretion (default medium/low).
2. REFACTOR comment injected at each source location (format per refactor skill: smell, severity, description) so future scans skip already-filed smells.
3. No duplication of prior closed smell items (6 IDs): filtered findings not filed; if a prior smell regressed, new item cites the original ID and regression evidence.
4. Filing is idempotent: re-running does not create duplicate children (reuse by canonical title or REFACTOR comment check).
5. Epic comment lists created child IDs with parent linkage.

## Minimal Implementation
- Iterate triaged inventory non-engine-move subset; for each: wl create --parent CG-0MTCOQIRQ00541EJ with severity/description/file location; inject REFACTOR comment via comment_injection helpers or manual // REFACTOR-<id> comment.
- Enforce dedup guard: check grep -r REFACTOR and prior 6 IDs before creating; skip or annotate regressed.
- Verify parent linkage (wl show CG-0MTCOQIRQ00541EJ --children shows new items).
- Record created IDs in epic comment.

## Dependencies
Depends on Hybrid smell detection: engine modules and Hybrid smell detection: example games & tests (both inventories complete).

## Deliverables
- Child work items for non-engine-move smells under epic
- REFACTOR comments injected at source locations
- Epic comment with created child IDs + counts

**Key Files:**
- `~/.pi/agent/skills/refactor/workitem_creation.py` — work item creation helpers
- `~/.pi/agent/skills/refactor/comment_injection.py` — REFACTOR comment injection
  Input: detection inventory artefact (epic comment or report)
